thread_text:
Priya Desai: Heads-up from recruiting ops: after the nightly ATS batch several candidates got duplicate interview invites and two scorecards attached for the same session. Seen for panels 10021/10022.
Zoe Brooks: Confirmed. DB shows two scorecard rows for cand_7712 and cand_7713 with identical content but different ingestion ids (batch_2026_06_20_02 vs batch_2026_06_20_02_retry).
Samir Khan: I see the batch worker retried on a transient timeout and the checkpoint wasn't committed before reprocessing. Importer currently doesn't enforce an idempotency key so retries can duplicate writes.
Maya Patel: Oof. That explains the duplicate invites. We need a mitigation to avoid interviewers being confused this afternoon. Can we suppress duplicate outgoing invites and collapse duplicate scorecards?
Samir Khan: Short plan: 1) patch importer to check ingestion_id + candidate_id + panel_id uniqueness (hotfix to canary), 2) add a small middleware rule to suppress duplicate calendar invites if we detect recent identical invites in the last 10m, 3) run a targeted dedupe job for the affected batch.
Zoe Brooks: I'll prepare the dedupe query and run a dry-run first. Sample dedupe command: `./tools/ats-dedupe --batch batch_2026_06_20_02 --dry-run`
Priya Desai: Also please flag any candidates who received two invites so recruiting can confirm cancellation with them. We had a candidate reply confused.
Samir Khan: Hotfix pushed to canary, making the importer idempotent by leveraging ingestion_id header. Canary tests show no duplicates on reprocess. Backfill/dedupe ETA 25m.
RecruitBot: created ticket R-2026-999: "ATS batch retry causing duplicate scorecards & invites" assigned to Samir Khan due 2026-06-30
Maya Patel: Good. After dedupe, paste counts: number of duplicate scorecards removed and number of duplicate invites cancelled. We'll include that in the postmortem and update the interviewer training note about how to spot/cancel duplicates.
Zoe Brooks: Dry-run results: would remove 28 duplicate scorecard rows across panels 10021/10022, 14 duplicate calendar invites. Running actual dedupe now.
Samir Khan: Dedupe ran: removed 28 duplicate scorecards, cancelled 14 duplicate invites. I'll follow up with a retro and a small test added to the batch worker CI to prevent regressions.
Priya Desai: Thanks. Also can we add one line in the interviewer guide: "If you see two invites for the same candidate/session, treat the later timestamp as canonical and notify recruiting ops" until the new checks fully roll out? I'll push that note.
Maya Patel: Perfect. Please link the postmortem ticket here when ready.
Samir Khan: Will do. Posting follow-up and PR link once merged. :thumbsup:
